standard_prerequisites.name: A perfect complex over the local ring Z/l^nZ is represented by a finite complex of finite free modules with differentials landing in l times the next term, unique up to isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the canonical representatives K_n^bullet and their uniform boundedness.

standard_prerequisites.name: The trace of an endomorphism of a bounded complex over Q_l computes as the alternating sum of traces on cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the limit trace with the trace on H^i(K_infinity tensor Q_l).

core_obligations: Each K_n is represented by a finite complex K_n^bullet of finite free Z/l^nZ-modules with K_n^p -> K_n^{p+1} of image in l K_n^{p+1}, unique up to isomorphism, and pi_n, varphi_n by maps of such complexes (proof lines 2613-2626). Since varphi_n^bullet is an isomorphism of complexes, the degrees and ranks are uniform in n, so K_infinity^i = lim K_n^i is a finite free Z_l-module and K_infinity^bullet is a finite complex (proof lines 2627-2636). The cohomology H^i(K_infinity^bullet) = lim H^i(K_n^bullet) by induction on the number of terms, giving part ii (proof lines 2636-2641). The Frobenius diagrams commute in the derived category, hence up to homotopy; lifting the homotopies inductively (possible since K_{n+1}^i is free and K_{n+1}^{i-1} -> K_n^{i-1} surjective) and replacing pi_n^bullet by pi^bullet + dh + hd makes the diagrams commute strictly, so pi_infinity^bullet = lim pi_n^bullet exists (proof lines 2643-2667). Part i: the traces t_n = sum (-1)^i Tr(pi_n^i) fit into t_infinity in Z_l, computed as sum (-1)^i Tr(pi_infinity^i | K_infinity^i) = sum (-1)^i Tr on K_infinity^i tensor Q_l = sum (-1)^i Tr on H^i(K_infinity^bullet tensor Q_l), the last step because over the field Q_l the complex is quasi-isomorphic to its cohomology, which is H_infinity^i tensor Q_l (proof lines 2667-2688).
proof_roadmap: Build the limit complex K_infinity^bullet from the canonical minimal representatives (proof lines 2613-2636).
Strictify the Frobenius endomorphisms by homotopy lifting and compare traces with the cohomological trace (proof lines 2643-2688).
